<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="toolbarBlur" x="-20%" y="-30%" width="140%" height="170%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="8"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="4" flood-color="#1F2125" flood-opacity=".12"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="21" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#1F2125">9:41</text>
    <line x1="330" y1="16" x2="330" y2="20" stroke="#1F2125" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="335" y1="13" x2="335" y2="20" stroke="#1F2125" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="340" y1="10" x2="340" y2="20" stroke="#1F2125" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="352" cy="16" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#1F2125" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="352" y1="16" x2="356" y2="12" stroke="#1F2125" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <rect x="365" y="10" width="20" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#1F2125" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="367.5" y="12.5" width="14" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#009A67"/>
    <rect x="385.5" y="13.5" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#1F2125"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Blurred top toolbar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="32" width="390" height="76" fill="#F3F5F6" opacity=".68" filter="url(#toolbarBlur)"/>
    <rect x="16" y="43" width="358" height="54" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".78"/>
    <circle cx="43" cy="70" r="20" fill="#F0FBF8"/>
    <polygon points="43,59 46,67 55,67 48,72 50,81 43,76 36,81 38,72 31,67 40,67" fill="#009A67"/>
    <text x="74" y="75" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#1F2125">Home</text>
    <polygon points="318,60 321,68 330,68 323,73 325,82 318,77 311,82 313,73 306,68 315,68" fill="#65A3FF"/>
    <polygon points="352,60 355,68 364,68 357,73 359,82 352,77 345,82 347,73 340,68 349,68" fill="#4367BC"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Main landing content -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="257" r="52" fill="#F0FBF8"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="257" r="39" fill="#B8EDDC"/>
    <polygon points="195,231 201,247 218,247 205,257 210,274 195,264 180,274 185,257 172,247 189,247" fill="#009A67"/>
    <text x="195" y="348" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="600" fill="#1F2125">Make today count</text>
    <text x="195" y="376" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#777777">Everything you need, right where you need it.</text>

    <!-- Quick access cards -->
    <rect x="19" y="424" width="352" height="1" fill="#F3F5F6"/>
    <text x="20" y="458" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#1F2125">Quick access</text>
    <text x="370" y="458" text-anchor="end" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#4367BC">See all</text>

    <g filter="url(#shadow)">
      <rect x="20" y="478" width="168" height="82" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    </g>
    <circle cx="49" cy="509" r="16" fill="#E3EEFF"/>
    <line x1="49" y1="500" x2="49" y2="518" stroke="#4367BC" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="40" y1="509" x2="58" y2="509" stroke="#4367BC" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="76" y="507" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#1F2125">New item</text>
    <text x="76" y="528" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#878B90">Start something fresh</text>

    <g filter="url(#shadow)">
      <rect x="202" y="478" width="168" height="82" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    </g>
    <circle cx="231" cy="509" r="16" fill="#EAF8E5"/>
    <polyline points="224,509 229,514 239,503" fill="none" stroke="#31BD00" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="258" y="507" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#1F2125">Your activity</text>
    <text x="258" y="528" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#878B90">Review recent updates</text>

    <!-- Small status strip -->
    <rect x="20" y="588" width="350" height="64" rx="12" fill="#F8F8F8"/>
    <circle cx="49" cy="620" r="7" fill="#31BD00"/>
    <text x="68" y="617" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#1F2125">You’re all caught up</text>
    <text x="68" y="638" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#878B90">No new notifications today</text>
    <polyline points="344,615 350,620 344,625" fill="none" stroke="#969CA5" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="744" width="390" height="100" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="20" y1="744" x2="370" y2="744" stroke="#F3F5F6" stroke-width="1"/>
    
    <!-- Home selected -->
    <rect x="23" y="755" width="72" height="34" rx="16" fill="#F0FBF8"/>
    <polygon points="59,761 49,769 49,780 56,780 56,773 62,773 62,780 69,780 69,769" fill="#009A67"/>
    <polyline points="47,769 59,759 71,769" fill="none" stroke="#009A67" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="59" y="807" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#009A67">Home</text>

    <!-- Explore -->
    <circle cx="146" cy="770" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#878B90" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="153" y1="777" x2="160" y2="784" stroke="#878B90" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="146" y="807" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#777777">Explore</text>

    <!-- Activity -->
    <rect x="218" y="761" width="18" height="18" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#878B90" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="222,771 226,775 233,766" fill="none" stroke="#878B90" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="227" y="807" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#777777">Activity</text>

    <!-- Profile -->
    <circle cx="318" cy="766" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#878B90" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="318" cy="779" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#878B90" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="318" y="807" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#777777">Profile</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Home indicator -->
  <rect x="145" y="831" width="100" height="4" rx="2" fill="#1F2125"/>
</svg>
